title: decision-question v1
description: THE WORDS OF ONE QUESTION WAITING FOR A PERSON, as a caller gives them: the whole question when one is added, and any subset of these fields when one is changed (decisions/Operations.ps1, operations add and update). It is also the shape kept inside a stored question-added record (schema/decision-event.v1). It says SHAPE only. Which fields a new question must carry, what a title must say, that a choice needs options and that no field may hold a secret are rules, and live in decisions/Rules.ps1, because a change names only the fields it changes and a draft-07 'required' cannot say 'required when added'. The field list here and the field table in decisions/Rules.ps1 are compared by test/test-decisions-rules.ps1, so neither can gain a field the other lacks. Every text is stored exactly as given: nothing is trimmed, and a text of any language is kept character for character.

title.description: The question itself, in plain words, on one line. Never only a number or a pull-request or issue reference: a reader with no other context must understand what is asked.

kind.description: How the question is answered: one of the names in decisions/question-kinds.json, the one table every caller and every way of showing reads. The list is closed there, not here, so a new kind is one entry in that table.

options.description: The choices of a question of kind choice, each on one line; at least two. Empty for every other kind.

parts.description: The sub-points of a question of kind parts; at least two. Empty for every other kind.

whatItIs.description: The background a person needs to answer. This or yesMeans must be given.

yesMeans.description: What happens if the answer is yes. This or whatItIs must be given.

recommendation.description: What the asker recommends. Empty when it has no view.

group.description: The heading the question is listed under, on one line.

groupNote.description: Background that belongs to the whole group. Optional.

waiting.description: Who is blocked until this is answered, one name per item. Empty means nobody is blocked.

files.description: Paths of files that give more detail, one per item. Paths only: nothing here is opened or run.

references.description: Pull-request and issue numbers, as references only, one per item. A reference never stands in for the title.

needsSecret.description: True when answering needs a login, a key or another secret. The secret itself is never stored here or in an answer; this flag is what lets a way of showing offer no box for it.
